thread_context: Where is my package? || We can help track your delivery.
resolution: You can track the latest delivery estimate from Your Orders.

thread_context: My delivery is late || Sorry for the delay.
resolution: Please check the updated delivery estimate in Your Orders.

thread_context: Tracking has not updated || We will investigate.
resolution: Tracking updates can take time while the carrier scans the parcel.

thread_context: I cannot sign in || We can help with account access.
resolution: Use the account recovery flow to reset access securely.

thread_context: My account is locked || Please verify your account.
resolution: Please use the sign-in help page and never share your password.

thread_context: I forgot my password || We can help reset it.
resolution: Use the password reset option on the sign-in page.

thread_context: I was charged twice || We are sorry about the charge.
resolution: A billing specialist should review duplicate charges.

thread_context: Why is there a charge? || We can review the order.
resolution: Check Your Orders and contact billing support for an unfamiliar charge.

thread_context: My payment failed || Try another payment method.
resolution: Confirm the payment details or try another available method.

thread_context: I need to return this || We can explain returns.
resolution: Start a return from Your Orders and follow the item-specific instructions.

thread_context: Can I get a refund? || We can review eligibility.
resolution: Refund eligibility depends on the order and item; request a return for review.

thread_context: My refund is missing || We will check the status.
resolution: Review the refund status in Your Orders; a specialist can investigate delays.

message_text: How do I change my address?
thread_context: How do I change my address? || We can help with the order.
resolution: Check whether the order can still be edited from Your Orders.

message_text: The item I received is damaged
thread_context: The item I received is damaged || We are sorry.
resolution: Use the order return or replacement options to report the damage.

thread_context: Can I cancel my order? || We can review the order status.
resolution: Open Your Orders and choose cancellation if it is still available.

thread_context: My account was hacked || Please secure your account.
resolution: This is urgent; use account recovery and ask a specialist to review the account.

thread_context: Someone used my card || We need to protect your account.
resolution: Please contact your bank and a billing specialist immediately; do not share card details here.

thread_context: This is urgent and unsafe || We need specialist help.
resolution: A specialist should review this urgently; do not share sensitive information publicly.

message_text: Where can I find product details?
thread_context: Where can I find product details? || We can help.
resolution: Check the product detail page for specifications and availability.

thread_context: The app is not working || We can troubleshoot.
resolution: Update the app; restart it; and contact support if the issue continues.
